notes.title: Devblog 1
notes.content:
I decided to start a development blog for this game and give people more information of what this game is about.
The most interesting thing in my opinion is creating your own spells, and there is an ellement adding randomness to this system.

[b]Pets[/b].
These are non-combat creatures that live in your house and give some bonuses to certain categories in the magic editor that would make your spells a little more powerful if you have the right pet.

In the world you can find them as inventory items or buy them from a merchant. If you find a pet that you already have, its level will increase and the bonuses it gives will also increase.
